events.title: Improv Comedy Jam Show (FREE)
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best free improv comedy show! The Improv Comedy Jam Show is an improvised comedy showcase extravaganza! The stage is set for a high-stakes collision of rising stars and seasoned pros. Together, they weave spontaneous prompts into pure comedic improvised wildfire. Witness lightning in a bottle as the quick-thinking comedians bring the house down in totally made-up-on the-spot scenes of hilarity. FREE EVENT - GRAB YOUR FREE TICKET NOW

events.title: Cage Match: Improv Comedy Showdown
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Every Thursday, the best indie improv teams face off against each other in the ultimate comedy showdown - Cage Match!!! Each week, the reigning Cage Match champions are challenged by a new team. Both teams get 15 minutes to wow the audience, who pick the winner. This is high octane laugh out loud improv comedy. Opening the show this week is the Montage - a free-flowing improv show featuring our most experienced and newest improvisers. Featuring Brisbane's best improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $10 ONLINE | $15 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Brisbane's Best Newest Improviser Heat 1 (improv comedy competition)
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! We are on the hunt to crown Brisbane’s Best Newest Improviser. Special prizes and glory awaits the improviser that can make it through the Heats unscathed and come out on top in the Grand Final. This competition will have it all: improv games, hilarious scenes and challenges, musical comedy, special guests, expert judges, and you cheering for your favourite improviser. Grab your tickets and come support Brisbane’s Best Newest Improviser. This will be fun! If you are interested in competing in Brisbane's Best Newest Improviser, please contact chris@bigforktheatre.com TICKETS ARE ONLY $20 ONLINE | $25 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Student Graduation Show: Improv Fundamentals, The Scene and Characters
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Our Improv students have been working hard learning all the basics of improv comedy, and now they get to showcase these new skills in a final graduation show! There are 3 improv classes graduating today: Foundations 1: Improv Fundamentals (Imogen's class) Foundations 2: The Scene (Chris' class) Foundations 3: Characters (John's class) Calling on friends, family, partners, work colleagues, and anyone else - come support this new crop of students as they take their improv journey to the next level. Featuring Brisbane's newest improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $10 ONLINE | $15 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Saturday Night Comedy: No Loose Threads & Women's Show
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! No Loose Threads headlines this banging show. Our newest show is the most famous improv format in the world, The Harold. 3 beats of huge characters, hilarious scenes and genius heightening. Making absolute comedy gold! Opening is Women's Show - one of our best shows. Featuring an amazing cast of improvisers, they're a little bit wild, a little bit cheeky, and always deliver killer comedy. They'll have you howling with laughter. Featuring Brisbane's best improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $20 ONLINE | $25 ON THE DOOR

events.title: John Comedy (improv comedy)
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Featuring Brisbane's only four comedians! John Comedy is a tight-knit group of Brisbane's only four comedians*, putting their best game into every scene. They take your dumb thoughts and turn them into hilarious scenes all created on the spot before your beautiful eyes. Gosh, did we mention how beautiful your eyes are? Each performance is like your favourite sketch show, except there is no script to fall back on. Think of shows like Portlandia - but done completely on the fly! This 6 times cage match winning ensemble and 2025 Big Fork Comedy Festival performers focus on finding organic games in their scenes, John Comedy weaves together hilarious scenes as they explore, and often ruin, their character's worlds. John Comedy, Game on! (*excluding Rove McManus) TICKETS $15 ONLINE | $20 ON DOOR

events.title: Saturday Night Comedy: Big Fork's Big Fun Showcase
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Featuring some of Brisbane’s funniest comedians, Big Fork’s Big Fun Showcase is exactly what make’s Big Fork Theatre Brisbane’s home of improv comedy! Expect a night of laughs, excitement and thrills as you sit on the edge of your seat wondering ‘was that really unscripted?’ Trust us – you couldn’t write this if you tried. In its 11th year of making audiences laugh and teaching the next generation of comedians, Big Fork Theatre is a Brisbane Institution. This Showcase shows off our purpose built theatre and what makes us one of Brisbane’s best nights out! Featuring funny scenes, musical improv, special guests and more, it’s an event not be missed. If you are a fan of Dropout TV, Who’s Line is it Anyway? or Thank God You’re Here, this is your gateway show to more hilarious nights at Big Fork Theatre, where every show is hilarious and completely unique. Featuring Brisbane's best improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $20 ONLINE | $25 ON THE DOOR
